column2: What'd you say!
Nothin'!
I can't tell if you two get along or not!
Ahahahaha!
We do NOT get along!
Come to think of it, how did Kedaman's house work? Did that have something to do with the Dimension Chain too?
Now that the Demon King has fallen and the Dimension Chain is over, no more outsiders should stray into the Kuryu Valley.
The battle with the Sanada ninja starts now.
Yeaaah...
Good luck, everyone!
I've watched your fight closely, {p}! It'll spur me on in the battles to come!
Say hi to the snrk-snff guy for me!
A boy like you bravely standing up to the Demon King... I was so moved! My chest is pounding!
Y-your chest...!? Well, that's... very fine indeed...
Kekko Kamen, thank you! No matter how much time passes, I'll never forget your body!
I'm hungry...
That's right, Nantomo-kun, you worked so hard! When we get back to the mansion, I'll treat you to a feast!
Iyahaya... nantomo...
Hee hee hee!
What's up, Kikkai-kun?
Nothin'!\n\nI'm just happy we get to go back to our world!
Come hang out at my place sometime!
At that kooky house?
Seeee ya!
Wait! Don't leave me behind!
Oh, Grandpa, you noticed?
{p}! Keep up the good work from here on, ya hear!
You too, Grandpa!
What's that supposed to mean!
Hee hee hee...!
Aaah! They've gone!
Pochi! It's your fault!
What!? Is that any way to talk to your master!? Think of a way to get back to our world!
It's always me doing the thinking! Some master you are!
Ooh, this light...!
We get to go home too!
...What kooky people.
Hey, hey, Ma...\n\nWhen we get back to our world, can I transfer to school as a boy?
As a boy? What does that mean?
Oh, no, no, nothin'! Hahaha...!
Come on, you lot, we're going home!
A boy who's a sukeban, and a girl named Danshi, which means "boy"... Maybe they were affected by the Dimension Chain too...?
Ahem! The case is splendidly solved! We're pulling out, Koyayashi-kun!
Ohh... it's solved... Then let's go hooome!
If you're ever in trouble again, consult this great detective! Hahaha!
More like a great defective...
Even if your body is taken, with a strong will your heart can't be taken. You taught me that.
Utsugi-san... But... the road waiting ahead of you is a hard one...
That's true. But you also taught me the courage to face it. Thank you. I'll never forget you...
The courage to face it...
I merely drove off outside enemies. Don't concern yourself. No thanks are needed!
Little boy, you were just my type!
I fought alongside you on Dr. Hell's orders, but
I like your guts!
Battle is what a Demon lives for.\n\nThese claws hunger for their next prey!
The Demon King's words were both beautiful and ugly. But they weren't Panther Claw's taste!
If the world has begun setting itself right, I'll return to my own world! To see my father Jawanbo defeat the Shutendoji!
Kyaaa, we get to go home! I'm so vewy happy!
Until Dante fulfills his mission, I remain with Dante. And it is not yet over...
With the Demon King defeated, the war between us, the Kibutsu Clan, and the Shutendoji is about to begin again!\n\nNow, back to my battlefield!
Creating a new mankind is the mission laid upon me. Fighting the Demon King who stood in its way was unavoidable! Farewell!
Boy... I shall wait... for my next awakening...
Even with the Demon King gone, my fight as a hunter of villains isn't over! Not until every villain in every world is gone!
Is anybody here?
Let's ask the townspeople.
I feel like someone's watching me...
Doesn't this place lead anywhere else?
So this is the mountain where Akira-kun said he fought Sirene...
This is... Ryo's house! But...
It's like the scenery around here has changed...
But if this is Ryo-kun's house, that's lucky!
Yeah. Let's go inside...
It's pitch dark. I hate this...
Something's glowing in the dark...?
Whoaaa! Th-there's something here!
Calm down. Look closely. It's an artifact.
An artifact...? Ah, Ryo!
So this is Ryo Asuka-kun?
This statue is the very image of the devil that humans hold. But this statue was found in strata older than the Ice Age!
But there shouldn't have been any humans back then...?
It sure doesn't look like something that formed naturally...
Something other than humans made it!
Something other than humans!?
The race that ruled the Earth before humans: the Demons! The devil that humans picture is the true form of the Demons, the planet's former inhabitants!
...Maybe Ryo's lost it?
This statue is a history book left by the Demons, who had no writing. Akira, put this statue on!
When you put this statue on, the Demons' world appears before you...
Th-that's creepy... Can't I do it next time?
You can't believe the word of your best friend!?
Ah, I'm a sucker for that line... Fine, I'll put it on.
Akira-kun...
WHOAAAA!!
Don't take it off!
B-but...!?
Akira! Look! Look closely!
WHOAAAA!!
Akira-kun, what on earth are you seeing?
A vision of hell, the world of devils!\n\nWeakness means death. A history of power, where only the strong survive!
